steps.title: Lee: accessible cafe signage · part 1
steps.detail: Lee asks for an accessible cafe signage. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Lee: accessible cafe signage · part 2
steps.detail: The accessible cafe signage now has conflicting notes. Lee wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Lee: accessible cafe signage · part 3
steps.detail: Lee is ready to introduce a paying client for the accessible cafe signage. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented accessible cafe signage. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Lee.
